Commentary.Commentary: Now, just 72 runs remain for India to win this game and 16 overs left in the day. Clearly it's a matter of when and not if now. Fancy India to win this game today itself? Or will Windies somehow manage to drag this into Day 4? Maybe some quick wickets early on to shake the Indians up a bit? We'll see what happens. If the hosts get close to the set target, play can be extended by 30 minutes to allow them to finish it off on Day 3 only. Join us on the other side of the break for the final innings of this match.

Pretty much India's match now. What a session for the home side. Incredible. They have bowled the Windies out inside two sessions with Umesh Yadav leading the charge again with a 4-wicket haul. He and Ashwin started things off and rocked the visitors early. There was some resistance provided, which involved Hope, Hetmyer, Chase, Ambris and Holder, all at different times of course, but it obviously wasn't enough. All the Indian bowlers chipped in with the wickets, with the pacer Yadav standing out as he got a 10-fer in this game.

OUT! Yes, he can! A 10-fer for Umesh. His first in Tests. Just one ball of his new spell was what it took for him to get it. He bowls it full and outside off, Gabriel swings away from his body. The delivery takes the inside edge and disturbs the furniture behind. WINDIES ARE ALL OUT FOR 127! INDIA ARE GIVEN A TARGET OF 72!
Umesh Yadav is back on. He has 9 wickets for the match. Can he take the last and take a 10-fer?
On off, kept out.
Pushed to the cover region by the batsman.
Tosses it above the eye line, Gabriel's eyes lit up there and he goes for the loft. The ball goes off the inner half towards mid-wicket and a run is taken.
Tosses it up on middle, the batsman keeps it out.
Shannon Gabriel is the last man to bat.
OUT! BOWLED 'EM! There goes number 9 and it falls it Ashwin. The straighter one does the trick as Warrican plays inside the line. The ball goes past the outside edge and uproots the off pole.
Played to the point region by the batsman. The fielder goes for a direct hit but misses the stumps. They pick up a single.

Another chance goes abegging! It is flatter around middle, Warrican tries to defend but the ball takes the inner half and goes between the hands and legs of Shaw at short leg. Should have been crouching a little more. He was up a little too early.
FOUR! Frustrating this for the Indians. Short and outside off, Warrican cuts it through backward point for a boundary.
Eased down to long on for a run.
Driven through mid on by the batsman. They pick up a single.
Very full on off, the batsman jams it out towards covers. Kohli there makes an acrobatic stop.
On middle, kept out.
FOUR! Back-to-back boundaries! Through the leg side this time. With the angle, Bishoo whips it through mid-wicket and the ball races away.
FOUR! Up and over! A little too full by Ashwin. Bishoo sees an opportunity to score and goes after it. Lofts it over mid off and a boundary results.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Another loopy ball outside off, it drifts in. Bishoo covers the off pole and keeps it out.
Tosses it up on middle, Bishoo pushes it back to the bowler.
On the stumps, the batter tries to defend but the ball goes off the inner half towards mid-wicket for a run.
Only two wickets left in this innings. India will look to get them ASAP and then finish off the game today itself so that they get two days off.
Drinks!
Full on off, pushed to covers.
Full on middle, flicked to mid-wicket.
Loopy ball on middle and leg, spins away sharply and hits Bishoo on the thigh pad.
In line of the stumps, hit back to Jadeja.
Full and outside off, bunted down.
Slower ball on off, plays with a straight bat but gets a soft leading edge towards the off side.
Floats it up on off, kept out.
The ball is down the leg side but the batsman still goes after it.
Another ball wide outside off, left alone. Ashwin needs to make the batter play a lot more. All these deliveries are being wasted.
A little too wide outside off, left alone.

DROPPED! But a brilliant effort by Rahane! Once again it is the straighter one from Ashwin on off, Warrican lunges and once again plays for the turn. There ain't any. The ball kisses the outside edge ang goes past the gloves of Rishabh Pant. Rahane at first slip, is quick to react as he dives to his left, gets a hand to it but the ball pops out. Tries to take it on the second attempt but fails to do so also. A life for JW, not sure though if he will make it count.
The straighter one outside off, Ambris lunges and tries to defend but gets beaten.
Full in line of the stumps, hit to mid on.
Full this time, hit back to Jaddu to his left.
Loopy ball outside off, played back along the turf.
Tossed up on off, driven back to the bowler.
Loopy ball around off, this time hits it away from the square leg fielder to get off strike.
Darted full and on leg, turned to the leg side.
On middle, kept out.
On the stumps, Bishoo lunges and dead bats it.
Tosses it up on middle, kept out.
Tosses it up on middle, kept out.
The carom ball on off, Bishoo is solid in defense.
BEATEN! Tosses it up around off, pitches and then turns away. Bishoo pushes at it but is beaten by the away turn.
Ravichandran Ashwin is into the attack now.
Flatter on off, kept out.
Jomel Warrican is in next.

OUT! Three reds and that is plumb! Jadeja gets two in two overs. One would wonder why wasn't he given the ball a lot more. He is just into his 8th over and has got three. This is flatter and slightly shorter around middle. Ambris misreads the length as he tries to pull. The ball sneaks underneath his bat and hits the front pad. The player appeals and the umpire raises his finger. Ambris has no choice but to go for the review. Replays roll in and it shows no involvement of the bat and also, the on-field call is the right one. The last recognized batsman for the Windies is back in the hut after getting a start and the end is nigh for them.
Windies take a review this time! Ambris is given out LBW and he has challenged the decision. Looks out though.
The arm ball on off, Ambris prods forward and defends it onto the ground.
Slightly shorter in length but the line is the same, around off, pushed back to the bowler.
Flatter and around off, the batsman lunges and defends it.
On off again, kept out.
Tosses this one up outside off, driven to short cover.
Full and on middle and leg, hit back to the bowler.
Low full toss outside off, hit with the inner half towards mid on.
Another one given air around off, Ambris opens the bat face and guides it towards backward point for one.
Quicker this one on off, Ambris plays it with a straight bat.
Loopy ball on the leg side, Ambris bunts it down.
Devendra Bishoo is the new man in.

OUT! Now we know why the Indians were so confident. There is a spike on Snicko and Holder is given his marching orders. Judicious use of the review by the Indians. Jadeja strikes as he gets his second. The partnership which was starting to build has been cut short. Ravindra bowls it flatter around off, it pitches and straightens a touch. Holder lunges and tries to defend but does not account for the turn. There is a sound as the ball passes the bat. Pant takes it and he appeals as he feels there is an edge. The umpire though feels different. The Indians review immediately and replays show the on-field call has to be overturned. Windies are effectively 52 for 7 now. India would look to take the remaining wickets as quickly as possible as they are into the tail.
Howzzat? Not out is the answer to that question. However, the Indians are very confident. Holder is the man in question.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Around off, it drifts into the batter. Holder lunges and keeps it out.
A little too full on off, Holder finds the cover fielder with a drive.
On middle, kept out.
Works it with the angle to mid-wicket.
On middle, Ambris dead bats it.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
OHHHH! The googly around off, it pitches and turns away. Ambris plays inside the line and gets beaten. Pant behind the stumps fails to collect it.
Gives it air on off, Holder eases it down to long off and takes one.
On middle, Holder lunges and defends it onto the ground.
Slower through the air on off, Holder pushes it to mid off.
Again, how good is Jadeja, keeps bowling it in one area. Ambris though gets right behind the line and keeps it out.
On off again, Ambris is solid in defense.
Darts it on off, Ambris defends it.
Outside off now, Holder drives it square on the off side for a run.
On the pads again, Holder tries to flick but misses to get hit on the pads.
Fires it on the pads, Holder works it to mid-wicket.
Ravindra Jadeja is into the attack.
The googly on middle, kept out.
Slower through the air on middle, the batter goes back and works it to short leg. Playing with ease are the two after the break.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Floats it up on off, it is driven back to the bowler.
Slower through the air on off, the batter guides it to point.
Floats it up on middle, the batsman pushes it back to the bowler.
Well played again! Lets the ball come to him and then plays it to deep point for a single. The lead is now 50. They would need a lot more though.
Good length on off, Ambris keeps it out.
On the pads, Ambris tries to flick but misses to get hit on the pads. The players appeal but nothing from the umpire. Going down leg.
On a length and around off, the batsman keeps it out.
Nicely played! Umesh bends his back on this one around off, Holder stands tall and with one hand off the handle, he guides it through point for a run.
Very full and on middle, Holder plays it with a straight bat to mid on.
Ends the over with a run by easing it down to long off. So 28 runs have been added by the Windies after the break. Good going for them till now.
FOUR! Lovely shot! Very delightful to the eye! Holder plants his front foot across and then caresses it through covers for a boundary. The lead now is closing in on the 50-run mark.
The googly this time, Holder does not pick it. He tries to flick but gets a soft leading edge to mid off.
Loopy ball on off, Holder pushes it back to the bowler.
On middle, worked with the turn to mid-wicket.
Floats it up on off, the batsman blocks it out.
Shortens his length this time and it is blocked out.
Close shave! The inside edge probably saved Ambris there. Another one of those full length inswingers. Ambris at the very end, gets an inside edge onto the pads and the ball rolls towards mid-wicket.
Just ahead of a length around off, the batter plants his front foot forward and times it to mid off.
FOUR! Too fine! On the pads, Ambris tickles it away down the leg side and the ball races away to the fence.
Now from wide of the crease and angles it on a length and around off. SA blocks it out.
Fullish and this one comes back in late. Ambris tries to drive but the ball goes off the inner half towards mid-wicket.
On the stumps, the batsman keeps it out. So runs are coming thick and fast for the Windies after the break.
Slightly quicker and on off, Holder pushes it to mid off.
SIX! Boom boom goes Holder! Kuldeep tosses it up around off, Holder's eyes lit up as soon as he saw the flight. He cleared his front leg and tonked it over the long on fence for a biggie.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Eases it down to long on for a run.

NOT OUT! No bat involved and the sound was of the bat hitting the ground. India lose a review.  Not sure why they took it as the bowler and the keeper weren't too excited. Kuldeep tosses it up very full outside off. Ambris tries to force it through the covers but misses. Pant takes it and there is a muted appeal but the umpire shakes his head. Kohli just in the nick of time, takes the review. Time for the replays and Snicko shows there was no willow on it.

A late review for a caught behind. There was not a loud appeal for it, Kohli though asks someone and then signals the 'T'. Could be a masterstroke if the decision is overturned. Ambris is the man in question.
Shortish and outside off, Ambris plays it through point and keeps strike. Another good over for the Windies. 7 from it.
The in-dipper this time around off, Ambris picks it early and flicks it through square leg for a brace.
Good delivery! Yadav angles it into the batter which means Ambris has to play at it. He gets it to straighten after pitching and the ball whizzes past the outside edge.
FOUR! Nicely played! There was width on offer outside off, Ambris waits for it and then guides it through gully, no one in the deep and the ball crosses the third man fence.
Fullish and on off again, looking to tail the ball back in late. It does not though and the batter times it to mid off.
Full and around off, the batsman strokes it to mid on.
Umesh Yadav to bowl from the other end.
On the stumps, Holder works it to mid-wicket. A good start for the visitors after the break.

The googly, now due to the slow nature of the pitch and due to the slower pace Kuldeep bowls at, Ambris is able to pick it after it bounces. He lets it spin away and then guides it through third man for three.
Slower through the air on middle, the batsman has a lot of time to watch what the ball is doing and work it to the man at square leg.
Flatter on off, it comes back in. Holder goes back and flicks it through square leg for a run.
Loopy ball again around off, Holder strokes it to mid off.
He starts off with a tossed up ball on middle, it comes slow off the surface and Ambris goes onto the back foot and works it towards fine leg for the first runs of the session.

We are back for what could probably be the last session of the game. Sunil Ambris and Jason Holder walk out to resume their innings. The Indians are out in a huddle and they now make their way to the middle. Kuldeep Yadav will start the proceedings for India in this session. Here we go...
... Day 3, Session 3 ...

Game over today itself, then?  The last batting pair is at the crease. The Windies will be hoping for some sort of a fight. Can they stretch the lead to around 100? Give something for their bowlers to bowl? Can they drag it to Monday? The answers will be made available from 1445 local (0915 GMT). 37 overs still left in the day, so plenty of time left for the match to finish.

It would be an understatement if we mention India bowled well. They were astoundingly clinical. Hardly any loose balls and even if there were, it was more due to the bowlers trying hard for spin or swing. Umesh Yadav has already registered his best figures in a match and is all poised to take a 10-fer and consecutive fifers.

Nothing went right for Windies in this session. They lost Brathwaite on the very second ball and kept losing wickets at regular intervals. There was a brief resistance, of 39, between Hope and Hetmyer but that was shut down too.
What a session. The game has been turned upside down. When India were bowled out for a not-so-big lead, it seemed like the match was in parity. But...
Outside off, left alone. TEA ON DAY 3, WINDIES LEAD BY 20!
FOUR! Too straight again, it is a full toss, on the pads, Holder gets it to the fine leg fence.
Played to the point region by the batsman. The batsmen have run through for a single.
On a length outside off, Ambris pushes at it away from his body and gets a thick inside edge towards square leg.
Ahhh... no hat-trick. Umesh going for a bit too much. Full and down the leg side, Holder misses his flick and the ball goes off his pads to the leg side. A leg bye taken.
Skipper Jason Holder walks in at number 8, replacing Dowrich. Around 5 minutes left for Tea. Can he avert the hat-trick?

OUT! The off stump is out of the ground!  Beautifully bowled again. Umesh Yadav is on the cusp of taking a hat-trick again and another fifer. The fast bowler bowls it really straight, around off, Dowrich looks to defend but gets a thin inside edge onto his pads, which deflects the ball to knock off the off stump. So WINDIES EFFECTIVELY ARE 14/6!!!
Outside off, pushed straight to point.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot.
Full and outside off, the googly, Ambris looks to pad it away and it goes to first slip.
Full and outside off, driven through the covers for a couple.
Driven through mid off by the batsman.
Full and outside off, pushed straight to cover.
Shane Dowrich walks in at number 7, replacing Chase. It is not Tea then. Play will go on till 1425 local (0855 GMT).

OUT! A wicket just moments before Tea! The Windies have lost half their side. Umesh has his second. A length ball, around off, Chase looks to defend but the ball moves in ever so slightly, takes the inside edge, hits the pad, then deflects onto the off stump. Big blow to the visiting side. Chase was one man who could have hung around. WINDIES ARE EFFECTIVELY 12/5.
A short ball, pulled to deep mid-wicket for a run.
Full and just outside off, driven back to Umesh. Ambris quickly moves away from the stumps just in case Umesh wants to have a shy. But the fast bowler does not even collect the ball properly.
Full and outside off, watchfully defended.
Full and around off, pushed back to the bowler.
Outside off, on a length, pushed through point for a single.
Could be the last over before Tea.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Full on middle, flicked towards mid-wicket where Virat Kohli makes a fine save.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
The batsman drives the ball straight down the ground. They pick up a single. That should have been stopped, ideally. Kuldeep lazily bent to his right and the ball went through his fingers.
On middle, pushed towards long on for a run.
Full and outside off, driven wide of mid off for a single.
Kuldeep Yadav is back on. 5-0-21-1 so far.
Full and outside off, pushed towards mid on.
FOUR! Too straight, Ambris tickles it fine and the ball races away.
Another LBW appeal shout goes down quickly. Similar to the previous ball, Ambris misses his flick again and gets hit on the pads. An inside edge is there along with it.
Around off, coming back in, SA misses his tuck and is hit on the pads. Umesh starts to appeal but then bails out. Probably an inside edge.

FOUR! WINDIES GET INTO THE LEAD. A short ball, around middle, Ambris swivels and pulls it behind square leg. Cheteshwar Pujara is stationed at deep mid-wicket and cannot get to the ball. First boundary for Sunil, who moves into 11.

The camera now pans to the Windies dressing room. Shane Dowrich is shown padded. This morning, he was going through the routines with his left knee strapped up. It will be interesting to see whether he can run efficiently. Could be a better idea to send him in at the spot of the last recognized batsman - possibly after Holder. Gives him more time to rest.
On a length outside off, watchfully defended to the bowler.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Outside off, punched past short extra cover and the bowler towards long off for a single.
Full and around off, pushed back to the bowler.
Maintains his line just outside off, length just short of full. Ambris pushes it towards cover.
Around middle and off, blocked back to the bowler.
Full and outside off, pushed towards cover.
A bouncer to end the over, RC ducks.
Full and outside off, driven straight to mid off.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
On middle, Roston works it towards mid-wicket.
Down the leg side, Chase misses his flick and the ball goes off his pads to the keeper.
Outside off, hits a crack and then rises steeply. Chase shoulders arms.
Full and outside off, watchfully defended.
Rishabh Pant is taking some time off. Drinks are on the field for him. Does not look too much in trouble, just taking some break.

PANT IS HIT ON THE GRILLE. This pitch is getting more and more difficult to play now. Full and outside off, Ambris gets a big stride forward and looks to defend but misses. The ball hits his front pad, then kicks off to Pant, hitting him on the helmet. Jadeja meanwhile, is confident that is out LBW and even urges Kohli to go for the review. Thankfully for India, the skipper resists. Impact was well outside off.
Full and just outside off, watchfully defended.
Full and just outside off, Sunil comes forward and dead-bats it.
On middle and off, pushed towards mid-wicket.
Tossed up on middle and off, Ambris comes forward and defends.
On middle and leg, flicked towards mid-wicket.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Full and around off, watchfully defended.

Down the leg side, Ambris leans, falls across a touch and flicks it without any control. The ball flies in the air and someone shouts, 'CATCH!' but it is far from the mid-wicket fielder. A single taken.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Down the leg side, left alone.
Umesh Yadav is back on. 4-2-16-1 so far.
Full and outside off, watchfully defended with a lunge.
Tossed up outside off, eased through the covers for a single.
Around off, watchfully defended.
Full and outside off, pushed straight to cover.
Landed outside off, Ambris reaches out to defend but misses.
Full and around off, watchfully defended.
On middle, helped through mid-wicket for a single.
Full and outside off, Chase leans and drives it wide of long off for a single.
Played to the point region by the batsman. Two runs added to the total. 50 UP FOR WINDIES, a big struggle.
Full on midle, defended towards the mid-wicket again.
Full and around off, Chase looks to drive but the ball goes off the inner half towards mid on where Virat Kohli misfields but no run is taken.
Around middle, helped towards square leg.
Full and outside off, pushed straight to cover.
That was fired. The speed gun shows 91 kph. Full and straight, on middle, SA gets his bat down in time and blocks.
Full again, driven straight to short extra cover.
Full and outside off, Sunil gets a big stride forward and pushes the ball to cover.
Down the leg side, tickled fine for a couple. The deficit is now 8.
Full and outside off, Ambris gets a big stride forward and defends.
Finally gets a result of his numerous attempted flicks. A single through mid-wicket to get him off the mark.
Action replay of the previous delivery.
A touch short, worked straight to square leg.
A tad short, around leg, spinning away, the googly, Ambris goes back and works it towards the mid-wicket again.
Similar line, flicked towards short mid-wicket.
Full and around off, watchfully defended.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat. A WICKET MAIDEN to start for Jadeja.
Down the leg side, Chase looks to flick but misses. The ball goes off his pads to the leg side.
Roston Chase walks in at number 6, replacing Hope.

OUT! Edged and taken! The pitch is not quite exploding but the Windies are imploding. 4 down now. Full and just outside off, Hope looks to defend but while trying to do so, his bat gets stuck behind his pad. As a result, it is not quite able to meet the pitch of the ball. Hence, an outside edge is induced which goes straight to Rahane. Just in case no one has noticed, the deficit has not been wiped out yet. Still 11 adrift.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Full and just outside off, watchfully pushed back.
Full and around off, pushed back to the bowler.
Sunil Ambris is the next man in for Windies. Also, Ravindra Jadeja is introduced into the bowling attack.

OUT! Kuldeep provides the breakthrough. Partnership of 39 has been broken. Hetmyer going for one too many. Spinning away from off, slow through the air, the southpaw is beaten in the flight as he gets an outside edge on his wild slog across the line. It pops up to Pujara at point who takes a simple catch. Timely strike for the hosts.
Full on middle and off, blocked off the front foot.
Spinning in on middle and leg, worked away on the leg side from the back foot. Single taken.
Leg spinner just outside off, Shai comes forward to block but is caught on the pads.
FOUR! Shot. Wonderful stride into the shot as he comes forward and drives it past the diving mid off fielder. The fielder moved to his left but can't get to it.
Flighted delivery outside off, comes forward and blocks it well.

Drinks are on the field. After an early stutter when Umesh Yadav sent both the openers packing, Hope and Hetmyer have regained some control. It will be interesting to see how they deal with the Indian spin attack.
Drills it after getting his front leg out of the way and finds long on. One run to end the over.
Shai comes onto the front foot and defends it rather safely.
The batsman has driven it through mid off. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Hope leans into the drive and caresses it through the cover. Pujara hares after it and after a long chase, pulls it back in with a slide. Three runs are taken.
Not much spin on this occasion, just around off, Shai is on the front foot to defend.
From over the wicket, full and quick on off, Hope goes back and punches it on the leg side.
Quite full on the stumps, dug back out in the direction of the bowler.
FOUR! A poor delivery from Kuldeep, a loopy full toss and Hetmyer puts it away. Takes a step out and flicks it through mid-wicket for a boundary.
Hetmyer makes use of his feet to get close to the pitch and blocks.
Driven to mid on. No run taken.
FOUR! Around the pads, poor line, Hetmyer gets low to this one and sweeps it across the fine leg fence for a boundary.
Full in length and on the stumps, kept out off the front foot.
A forward defense from the inner half in front of short leg. End of the over.
Full on the stumps, driven back to the bowler.
The ball seems to have lost its shape as it's confirmed by the umpire after putting it through the 8-shape gauge. A replacement has been called for.
A touch short, the southpaw rocks onto the back foot and offers a firm punch square on the off side for a run.
A lot of air on this one, blocked well with the full face.
Comes forward and wrists it down towards long on. Single taken.
Ashwin comes from around the wicket to Hope and darts it across, full in length. It's defended off the outer half square on the off side.
Hope steps out, takes it on the full and whips it to long on to keep strike.
The googly, whipped away through square leg for one.
Leg spinner around off, Hetmyer looks to put bat on ball but gets beaten due to the late spin.
Full and straight, Shimron gets forward and defends before the ball can turn.
Spinning in from a shorter length on middle and leg, Shai goes back and works it past short leg. A single results.
Floats it right up there, outside off, Hope is on the front foot to defend.
Kuldeep Yadav into the attack.
Quite slow through the air, on leg stump, paddle swept down towards fine leg. A couple of runs are taken.
Plants his front foot forward to this full ball and blocks.
Full on middle stump, blocked off the inner half on the leg side.
Hetmyer comes well forward to this flighted ball and blocks it with the full face of the bat.
Straighter one on middle, worked down on the leg side.
Beaten! Spinning away from outside off, Hetmyer goes back to cut but the extra bounce takes it past the edge.
Full ball attacking the base of off stump, played back to Umesh to end the over.
Drives it towards mid on but can't get it past the fielder.
Keeps it full, just outside the off stick, Shai Hope responds with a defensive bat.
Length delivery outside off, arms are shouldered to this one.
Quite full, on middle, Hope adjusts well to bring a straight blade down in defense.
Full length delivery outside off, Hope is half-forward as he defends it away on the off side.
Loopy and full on middle, the left-hander brings his bat ahead of his pad and defends it safely.
The batsman rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball.
Sliding in on middle and leg, keeps going further down, catches Hetmyer on the pads but it's going down leg. So the appeal is turned down.
Hetmyer is on the back foot to this short ball and forces it away past silly point.
Short and flat, on off, punched away on the off side.
Quicker one on off, Shimron goes back and defends it down on the track.
Goes full and it swings away from outside off, left alone for the keeper to collect.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Spills it on the pads, flicked through square leg for a brace.
FOUR! Beautiful. So pleasing to watch. Full in length and outside off, Hope drives it between extra cover and mid off perfectly. The timing is such that there's no point chasing after it.

Aggression from Yadav. Hope drives it back to the bowler and he's a step out of his crease. Seeing this, Umesh scores a direct hit at the striker's end. The ball deflects towards point, but the batsmen don't take a run.

FOUR! That's a good shot in the end. Full ball attacking the stump, Hope was initially going to flick but then straightened his bat at the last second to drive it right back past the bowler. A boundary.

Edged and FOUR! Did that carry to Rahane? Maybe. Difficult chance either way. Spinning away, Hetmyer comes forward to block but it takes a thick edge and flies past the slip fielder. Maybe he got something on it, either way, the ball races away to the third man fence.
Rising off the surface as it's pitched outside off, left alone.
Quite full and outside off, dug out on the off side by Hetmyer.
Shimron Hetmyer is the new man in.

OUT! It is clean and Powell has to make the long walk. Both openers are back in the dugout now within 4 overs. Loopy and on a driving length around off, it spins away ever so slightly as Powell is forward in defense. It takes the outside edge and goes behind to Rahane at first slip who gets low to his left and takes it. It looks a bit dicey, so the umpires refer it upstairs. Replays show that Rahane got his fingers underneath the ball. Second wicket down for Windies as both openers are dismissed for a duck.
Kieran Powell has been caught at first slip, but it's taken upstairs as the umpires want to check if the catch is taken cleanly or not. The soft signal is out.
Slightly slower through the air, outside off, Powell covers the line and defends.
Fuller and quicker outside off, blocked down in front of silly point.
Spills it on the pads again, clipped through backward square leg. Jadeja from fine leg cuts it off and keeps the batsmen down to two.
FOUR! Too full and too straight from Umesh, Hope leans ahead and flicks this neatly through mid-wicket to find the fence. Lovely shot.
That's the perfect line and the perfect length. Keeps it on that fourth stump line, has pace, shape and a hint of away swing. Hope prods forward and shoulders arms.
Good carry for Umesh. Good length delivery in the channel outside off, rises too as Pant takes it in front of his face.
Length ball on off with some shape away after coming in at first, Hope opens his body up a bit as he defends it down in front of point.
Too far outside off, on a good length, no shot offered by the batsman.
Gets right behind the line of this one and plays it away from danger.
Arm ball, sliding in on middle and a little short in length too, Powell goes deep inside the crease and blocks it out.
Landing on off before going away again, Kieran shoulders arms once more.
Straighter one, fired quicker outside off, Powell has nothing to do with it.
Spinning away from outside off, left alone.

Didn't carry! Oh, there was an inside edge for sure. Powell survives. Ashwin comes from around the wicket and drifts it in on off, Powell comes half-forward to defend and gets an inside edge back onto his front pad. It falls just in front of Shaw at silly point.
Ravichandran Ashwin to bowl from the other end. He will share the new ball with Umesh.
Eventful first over from Umesh Yadav. A wicket maiden to begin things. Full and fired in on middle and leg, flicked gently on the leg side.
Heavy movement as the ball swings away from outside off, Hope leaves it alone.
Coming in at first and then straightening up after pitching, on off, Hope is squared up a bit as he defends it off the outer half square on the off side.
Outside off on a good length, left alone.
Shai Hope walks in at no.3.

OUT! GONE! Umesh draws first blood. Continuing from where he left off in the last innings. Bit fortunate though, as this can be considered as a soft dismissal. Full and down the leg side, Brathwaite looks to tickle it fine. Gets a feather on it and Pant behind the stumps dives to his left and takes a superb catch.

Oh! Action right off the bat... both literally and figuratively. Umesh was on a hat-trick and he just about missed out. Bowls an outswinger, a low full toss on off, Brathwaite brings a straight bat down and sends it to gully on the bump. Close one.
